sub_items.description: Trailer segment: Alex Clark on forgiveness, 2 Timothy 3:6-7, women and false teachers, the "Candace phenomenon," Gnosticism, and secret knowledge.

Andrew Kolvet video: announces Commit 100 program surge, frames vandalism as "enemy intended for evil," promotes tpaction.com/100, states a $10,000 reward has been posted by "friends of Charlie and Erika" for tips leading to vandal arrest.

Erica Kirk tweet asserting that Charlie said "we should be building two statues for every statue that they tear down," that "they think spray paint can obscure his legacy," invoking Jesus Christ / "God will not be mocked," and calling to "clean up the mess and restore Charlie's statue and keep building."
Tyler Bowyer tweet responding to vandalism, stating "what the left did to our headquarters today," pivoting to the Commit 100 / "chase the ballots" TP Action program with link.

Andrew Kolvet tweet: "Why haven't we heard from Katie Hobbs or anyone with a D next to their name after Charlie's statue was vandalized? Is it because they're terrified it was one of their own activists behind it? We are working with law enforcement and pulling video from neighboring buildings. We want these people arrested."
Blake Neff bookmark of Candace Owens' tweet predicting Erica Kirk Vanity Fair spread with children, after Candace had written "Save this tweet. It will age well."

Instagram segment by @take.naps (Bobby Sausalito) overlaid on the Frank Turek interview; commentary includes "you can't both be telling the truth," "it's an irrelevant consequence or an irrelevant u detail," and a false-binary critique of Turek's "doesn't impact who killed Charlie" framing.

Frank Turek on Jeremy Boreing's show acknowledging the CPR "incongruity" with Brian Harpole, calling it "irrelevant," analogizing to the New Testament resurrection, and partially backtracking: "Brian's generally right. No, we weren't doing CPR. I just tried it in the last few seconds, the last 20 to 30 seconds."

Enhanced surveillance/security-style footage showing Terryl Farnsworth seated in the back of a Mercedes Sprinter van (described as appearing to belong to the AV team) using a laptop, looking around, and crouching; timestamped by host to approximately 1:00 PM on September 10 – roughly 30 minutes after the event.

Exclusive surveillance footage referenced as ~11:53 AM on September 10 (per police warrants, per host), showing the figure in the black long-sleeve American-flag shirt: walking into position, standing, taking out a phone, texting for an extended period, descending, and bending the right foot; later segment showing the same figure walking up to the position with what host describes as a remembered limp. Host frames the right-foot bend as incompatible with a waistband gun and notes side-profile bulk larger than Tyler Robinson.

Selected top comments from prior Thursday tribute episode, read aloud by host: Pam ("proper and beautiful eulogy"), Fields ("makes him feel like a friend"), Lindsay ("never-before-seen clips"), Katherine Williams ("St. Joan, your grandpa, and Charlie"), Talks with Tiff ("Charlie Kirk finally got the eulogy he deserved"), Margaret ("exactly what he would have loved"), Tina Maples ("beautiful tribute"), Tina Curious ("freedom shirt"), Alaska dog lady ("they are now trying to pretend this is Gnostic… I just know the government lies to us").
Host refers to and gestures at a displayed image of the TPUSA Charlie Kirk statue showing red paint and a crossed-out element; host states the alleged vandalism occurred "early morning of the 13th."

Host describes a flurry of viewer emails, many from electricians, saying the matching light-brown shoes worn by the security detail and Butch Hibbs are electrical-hazard protection footwear, with links sent in (verbal reference; no displayed artifact)
Host verbal reference to last Wednesday's footage of Blake Harreff in what she presumes are Timpanogos Hospital scrubs by nighttime (not shown in this episode)
Collage of Jeremy Boreing's public remarks about the host, shown on three cards, with phrases such as 'The Daily Wire created a monster' and 'Why women believe Candace?' read aloud
Viewer comments under Alex Clark's trailer video shown on screen, including complaints about the timing and about being blocked
Host verbal reference to Vanity Fair contacting her over the weekend for comment on an imminent article about Erika Kirk (not shown)

nodes.name: Statue Vandalism Investigation
nodes.description: Persistent target: alleged vandalism of TPUSA Charlie Kirk statue with red paint on or about September 13, 2026. Open questions include: actual perpetrators, whether on-campus surveillance footage exists and will be released, the authenticity of the photo circulating, partisan attribution, and the simultaneous pivot to TP Action fundraising.

claims.label: Erica Kirk tweet on building two statues
claims.claim: Erica Kirk posted a tweet invoking Charlie's purported "build two statues" line, framing the alleged statue vandalism as spiritual persecution and calling for restoration of the statue.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate original tweet with timestamp; cross-check against TPUSA verified accounts; verify exact attribution.

claims.label: Tyler Bowyer tweeted TP Action Commit 100 / ballot-chase link in response to vandalism
claims.claim: Tyler Bowyer, identified by host as running TP Action, posted the Commit 100 / Chase the Ballots program link as the action item in response to the alleged statue vandalism.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the original tweet with timestamp; confirm author and program URL.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet demanded Democratic response to vandalism
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet tweeted asking why Katie Hobbs or "anyone with a D next to their name" had not commented on the alleged statue vandalism, asserting TPUSA was working with law enforcement and "pulling video from neighboring buildings."
claims.investigative_direction: Pull original tweet; verify which "neighboring buildings"; confirm whether on-campus surveillance footage is or is not in TPUSA possession.

claims.label: Blake Neff bookmarked Candace's Vanity Fair prediction tweet
claims.claim: Blake Neff bookmarked Candace Owens's tweet predicting an Erica Kirk Vanity Fair spread with the children ("Save this tweet. It will age well"), and Candace states she has since been contacted by Vanity Fair for comment.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull original bookmark record; await release of Vanity Fair article to verify prediction's accuracy.

claims.label: Alex Clark cited 2 Timothy 3:6-7 on women and false teachers
claims.claim: Alex Clark, in her 9/10 trailer, invoked 2 Timothy 3:6-7 ("false teachers who are creeping into households capturing weak women") and applied it to the "Candace phenomenon."
claims.investigative_direction: Pull full Alex Clark episode and verify transcript against the trailer excerpt.

claims.label: Alex Clark asserted Christ does not forgive those who do not repent
claims.claim: Alex Clark stated "Christ doesn't forgive everyone. He forgives those who repent and turn and trust in him by faith. But forgiveness is something that you can't actually offer somebody if they haven't repented."
claims.investigative_direction: Pull full Alex Clark episode; verify quotation against the trailer.

claims.label: Frank Turek called CPR discrepancy "irrelevant"
claims.claim: Frank Turek acknowledged the discrepancy between his account (he performed CPR) and Brian Harpole's account (he did not), but stated the discrepancy is "irrelevant" and "has no bearing on who killed Charlie Kirk."
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the full Boreing/Turek episode and reconcile with Turek's prior statements about the car ride.

claims.label: Frank Turek partially backtracked on CPR claim
claims.claim: Frank Turek conceded "Brian's generally right. No, we weren't doing CPR. I just tried it in the last few seconds, the last 20 to 30 seconds" – shifting his account in the same interview segment.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the full Boreing/Turek episode; compare to prior Turek statements on the car ride timeline.

claims.label: Bobby Sausalito: "You can't both be telling the truth"
claims.claim: Bobby Sausalito, in the Instagram clip displayed by host, explicitly stated "you can't both be telling the truth" regarding Turek and Harpole, and critiqued Turek's "irrelevant detail" framing as a false binary.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull original Sausalito clip; verify quotation.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet announced $10,000 reward for vandalism tips
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet stated that "friends of Charlie and Erika" have posted a $10,000 reward for tips leading to the arrest of the vandals, to be sent to law enforcement.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify which "friends" funded the reward; verify any law enforcement bulletin.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet stated Commit 100 program surged after vandalism news
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet stated the Commit 100 program "has been surging" after the vandalism news, framing the surge as a positive response to "evil."
claims.investigative_direction: Compare against any public Commit 100 signup metrics or TP Action disclosures.

claims.label: Host observation: suspect's right foot bends awkwardly when descending
claims.claim: In the displayed walking footage, the figure in the black long-sleeve shirt bends the right foot fully when descending into position, which host argues is inconsistent with concealing a full-sized firearm in a waistband or pocket on that side.
claims.investigative_direction: Forensically examine original footage; compare to published images of Tyler Robinson's known footwear and gait.

claims.label: Host observation: suspect appears bulkier in side profile than Tyler Robinson
claims.claim: From side-profile footage, host observes the figure in the black shirt appears bulkier than the figure shown in earlier maroon-shirt imagery, raising a possible decoy hypothesis.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain uncropped / unenhanced source frames; biometric and clothing comparison.

claims.label: Host observation: suspect appears to forget which leg to limp on
claims.claim: In the walking-up segment, host observes the figure's gait as a "remembered" limp, including a mid-stride course correction, which host interprets as the limp being performative rather than functional.
claims.investigative_direction: Gait analysis of unenhanced source footage; consultation with qualified forensic analyst.

claims.label: Host Says Terryl Farnsworth Was on a Laptop in a Mercedes Sprinter Van at About 1:00 PM
claims.claim: The host says enhanced footage shows Terryl Farnsworth seated in the back of a Mercedes Sprinter van, working on a laptop and looking around (she says this is her inference), at approximately 1:00 PM on September 10, roughly 30 minutes after the event.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the source of the footage; confirm provenance; subpoena any chain-of-custody record for the SD cards / thumb drives.

claims.label: Host Says the Figure in the Footage Was Texting Before Walking Down the Stairs
claims.claim: The host says the footage shows the figure standing in one spot for a long time, apparently texting on his phone, before walking down the stairs.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original footage timestamps; review phone extraction records if available.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA / Affiliates Claimed Statue Vandalized with Red Paint on September 13
claims.claim: The host says TPUSA and affiliated accounts (Andrew Kolvet, Erica Kirk, Tyler Bowyer) characterized the statue as having been vandalized with red paint, in some accounts crossing out the name of Jesus Christ, on or about the early morning of September 13, 2026; she plays a clip in which Andrew Kolvet discusses the act of vandalism.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm police / Tempenogo PD report; review any TPUSA-released surveillance or police bulletin.

claims.label: Host rejects Alex Clark's forgiveness/repentance framework
claims.claim: Host rejects Alex Clark's framework that forgiveness requires repentance, characterizing it as a misuse of scripture to delegitimize women who are noticing discrepancies, and stating "I forgive you, Alex."
claims.investigative_direction: Note as host stance against displayed source; cross-reference with theological commentary.

claims.label: Host concurs with Bobby Sausalito's interpretation of Turek contradiction
claims.claim: Host explicitly endorses Bobby Sausalito's framing that Turek's escalating list of euphemisms (discrepancy, incongruity, irrelevant detail, irrelevant consequence) is not a satisfying response to a documented contradiction, and rejects Turek's claim that the contradiction does not matter.
claims.investigative_direction: Preserve both artifacts; treat host concurrence as separate claim linked to the same evidence base.

claims.label: Viewer tip emails say the security detail's matching shoes are electrical-hazard footwear
claims.claim: The host reports receiving a flurry of viewer emails, many from people who work as electricians, saying the matching light-brown shoes worn by the security detail and by Butch Hibbs are electrical-hazard protection shoes used in labor trades; she shares this without further context and invites more tips.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the shoe model from the security-detail footage and confirm whether it is sold as electrical-hazard (EH-rated) footwear.
claims.transcript_snippet: They sent links that these are like electrical hazard protection shoes.

claims.label: Host says TPUSA blames the left for statue vandalism without positive evidence
claims.claim: The host says Turning Point USA put up a statue of Charlie Kirk at its Arizona headquarters and, two days later, claimed without any positive evidence that the left had vandalized it with red paint.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the date of the unveiling and the police report or TPUSA statement attributing the vandalism to the left.
claims.transcript_snippet: they did erect a statue of Charlie in front of their campus. Two days later, they now claim without any positive evidence, by the way, that the left

claims.label: Host says Blake Harreff was in Timpanogos scrubs by nighttime despite no blood
claims.claim: The host says Blake Harreff, a member of Charlie Kirk's security detail on September 10, had no blood on him and did not help carry or transport Charlie, yet was later seen wearing what she presumes are Timpanogos Hospital scrubs.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the UVU-return footage, hospital visitor and scrub-issue records, and any statement from Harreff on when and why he changed.
claims.transcript_snippet: we discovered that rather mysteriously uh he's wearing scrubs from Temponogus Hospital. Presumably by nighttime he's wearing hospital scrubs.

claims.label: Host says Turek's account is that hospital staff were handing out scrubs
claims.claim: The host says that, per stories shared by Frank Turek, everybody was being handed scrubs at the hospital, and that she cannot think of a reason Harreff in particular would wear them.
claims.investigative_direction: Find Turek's original statement about scrubs being handed out and ask Timpanogos Hospital whether scrubs were given to non-patients that day.
claims.transcript_snippet: on the basis of the stories that have been shared by Frank Couturk. Everybody they were just handing these scrubs out.

claims.label: Host says feds did not collect Kirk's bloodied necklace and microphone
claims.claim: The host argues the feds would not have taken Blake Harreff's blood-free shirt while leaving Charlie Kirk's bloodied necklace and bloodied microphone uncollected.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the FBI evidence inventory for the necklace, the microphone and clothing items collected on September 10.
claims.transcript_snippet: why would the feds collect Blake Harreff's shirt, which had no blood in it, but not collect Charlie Kirk's bloodied necklace and the bloodied microphone.

claims.label: Host says Charlie's blood-stained sports coat was released immediately and went to Arizona
claims.claim: The host says the feds immediately released Charlie Kirk's sports coat, worn at the Salt Lake City restaurant event and bloodied because it was in the back of the car, and that it went back home to Arizona.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm with the family or TPUSA when the coat was returned and whether any agency examined it.
claims.transcript_snippet: namely his sports coat that he had on at the restaurant event that took place in Salt Lake City and that had blood blood on it

claims.label: Host relays a theory that Harreff's clothing was taken over explosive residue
claims.claim: The host relays viewers' suggestion that Harreff's clothing was taken out of caution because he slid across the table and may have picked up explosive residue, and says that would fit the soil removal and emergency pavers if an explosive took Charlie out.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask which agency collected clothing from people near Charlie and whether swabs for residue were taken.
claims.transcript_snippet: Blake when he slid across the table may have got some explosive residue on him.

claims.label: Host says she released car photos never meant to be public
claims.claim: The host says she released, following the assassination, photos of the condition of the car that were never meant to be released, and wants Frank Turek to address them.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the photo set, its source and the date the host released it.
claims.transcript_snippet: address the condition of the car photos which were never meant to be released that we released following the assassination.

claims.label: Host says she has been stalked by former employer Jeremy Boreing for three years
claims.claim: The host says that for the last three years she has been stalked by her former employer, Jeremy Boreing, former Daily Wire CEO, who fired her.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare against Boreing's own public statements and the legal filings the host cites.
claims.transcript_snippet: I've told you guys that for the last three years, I've been stalked by my former employer

claims.label: Host says Boreing declared he would be content if his only contribution were destroying her
claims.claim: The host says Boreing publicly declared that if his only contribution to the world were trying to destroy her, he would be content with the rest of his life.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original Boreing remark and its date.
claims.transcript_snippet: He even declared publicly that if his only contribution to the world is trying to destroy me, he's he'd be content with the rest of his life.

claims.label: Host says Boreing praised Loomer and compared Jessica Reed Kraus to her
claims.claim: The host says Boreing referred to Laura Loomer as a national treasure and told Jessica Reed Kraus that she has all the same natural talents as the host.
claims.investigative_direction: Find the Boreing episodes or posts with the Loomer and Kraus remarks.
claims.transcript_snippet: he's referred to Laura Loomer as a national treasure in this pursuit. He told House in habit like Jessica Reed Krauss that she has all the same natural talents as Candace.

claims.label: Host shows a collage of Boreing remarks about her as evidence of fixation
claims.claim: The host shows a collage of clips of Jeremy Boreing speaking about her, which she says fits on three cards and is not exhaustive.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull each clip in the collage to its source episode and verify the wording.
claims.transcript_snippet: This is a real collage and by no means is it extensive.

claims.label: Host says Boreing plans to tour with TPUSA Faith
claims.claim: The host says Jeremy Boreing is now talking about touring with Turning Point USA Faith.
claims.investigative_direction: Find Boreing's statement and any TPUSA Faith tour announcement.
claims.transcript_snippet: he's now talking about how he's going to be touring with Turning Point USA Faith.

claims.label: Host says Boreing was never friends with Charlie Kirk
claims.claim: The host says Jeremy Boreing was never friends with Charlie Kirk and did not know him, and keeps inserting himself in the Charlie Kirk narrative.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask TPUSA or Boreing whether he ever met or worked with Kirk.
claims.transcript_snippet: He was never friends with Charlie Kirk. He didn't know Charlie Kirk.

claims.label: Host says she dealt privately in court with Boreing's conduct
claims.claim: The host says she had to deal with Boreing's behavior privately in court and is glad it is now public.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the court proceedings between the host and Boreing or the Daily Wire.
claims.transcript_snippet: So, I had to deal with it privately in court and now people just get to see how crazy this man is.

claims.label: Sausalito asks how Turek could do CPR from the trunk without Harpole noticing
claims.claim: In the clip the host plays, Bobby Sausalito asks how Frank Turek could have given CPR if he was in the trunk, and how Brian Harpole would not remember him jumping over the seat to do it.
claims.investigative_direction: Establish where in the SUV Turek sat and whether the seats allowed access to Charlie from there.
claims.transcript_snippet: If you were in the trunk, how did you do that? And how would Brian not remember you jumping over the seat to do it?

claims.label: Host says CPR is not subtle and would have needed help laying Charlie out
claims.claim: The host says CPR is not a subtle thing, that 30 seconds of a short ride is a long time Brian Harpole would remember, and that someone would have needed help laying Charlie's body correctly to do CPR.
claims.investigative_direction: Reconstruct seating and positioning in the SUV from photos and interviews with those aboard.
claims.transcript_snippet: It's CPR is not a subtle thing that you do, right? It it takes a lot. You would need help actually to lay Charlie's body in the correct way and to do CPR.

claims.label: Host says Brian Harpole is suing her over her account of his care
claims.claim: The host says Brian Harpole is suing her over her saying he provided upstanding care, which makes the CPR discrepancy more relevant to her than to others.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the Harpole complaint and docket to confirm the claims pleaded.
claims.transcript_snippet: I mean, I got Brian Harpell suing me on the basis of saying that he was just did all this upstanding care.

claims.label: Host says she has never suggested Turek murdered Charlie
claims.claim: The host says she has never suggested that Frank Turek murdered Charlie Kirk, but that people around Charlie in his final days have told lies since the beginning.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the host's prior statements about Turek for any such suggestion.
claims.transcript_snippet: And we have never suggested that you murdered Charlie.

claims.label: Host says Officer Bagley testified the black-shirt figure is the maroon-shirt figure because of sneakers
claims.claim: The host says Officer Bagley testified that the figure in the black American-flag shirt is the same person as the one in the maroon shirt because both wore sneakers, and calls that implausible on a college campus.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull Bagley's preliminary hearing testimony on how he linked the two figures.
claims.transcript_snippet: Officer Bagley testifies. He knows this is the same person as the person that's in the maroon because they're both wearing sneakers.

claims.label: Host says police warrants date the footage to about 11:53 AM, thirty minutes before the blast
claims.claim: The host says that according to the police warrants the shown footage is from about 11:53 AM, roughly 30 minutes before the sound of the explosive.
claims.investigative_direction: Read the warrant affidavits for the stated time of the footage and the time of the shot.
claims.transcript_snippet: according to the police warrants, this is approximately at 11:53 in the morning. So, we are talking 30 minutes before the sound of the explosive goes off.

claims.label: Host says the figure plainly has no gun in his waist
claims.claim: The host says it is obvious to her that the figure has no gun in his waist and that a gun of that size could not sit in a back pocket either, given the bent right foot.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain unenhanced footage for independent analysis of carry position and gait.
claims.transcript_snippet: it's so obvious to me at this moment that he does not have a gun in his waist at all.

claims.label: Host says SBI testified it was given thumb drives, not the original SD cards
claims.claim: The host says SBI testimony shows investigators were not handed the original SD cards but thumb drives, and asks how that is not tampering with evidence.
claims.investigative_direction: Read the preliminary hearing transcript for the SBI witness's description of what media was received.
claims.transcript_snippet: the accounts that came from the SBI that testified about what they were handed that they were not handed the original SD cards but were rather given uh the um thumb drives.

claims.label: Host infers footage shows Farnsworth's technology was not fully seized and evidence may be tampered with
claims.claim: The host says the Farnsworth footage is enough to infer some evidence may have been tampered with, and asks how his technology was not fully seized.
claims.investigative_direction: Request the evidence-seizure record for Farnsworth's laptop and storage media.
claims.transcript_snippet: this is enough to infer that some evidence may have been tampered with.

claims.label: Host says the preliminary hearing showed Farnsworth sent files to the FBI via Google
claims.claim: The host says the preliminary hearing revealed Terryl Farnsworth immediately sent files to the FBI via Google, contradicting what he told her about not knowing how to send a file.

claims.label: Host says officials now say the gun may have been in his waistband not near the ankle
claims.claim: The host says officials are now suggesting the gun could have been in his waistband rather than by his ankle, which she argues would not explain a limp.
claims.investigative_direction: Find the official statements on where the gun was carried and when they changed.
claims.transcript_snippet: They're now kind of trying to make it seem as though, oh, we actually were saying it could potentially be in his waistband and not um by his ankle.

claims.label: Host says the black-shirt figure is a decoy and a military-skilled individual

claims.transcript_snippet: I don't think that's the same person as the maroon person. I don't even think that that's the same person as who actually goes onto the rooftop.

claims.label: Host lists Turek among those she says wore scrubs on returning from the hospital
claims.claim: The host says her questions about what took place at the hospital and why people were wearing scrubs when they returned include Frank Turek, whose memory-lapse story she does not buy.

claims.transcript_snippet: what took place at the hospital and why people were wearing scrubs when they returned. And that includes Frank Turek

claims.label: Host says Alex Clark timed the trailer for 9/10 because they blame the host for views of Erika and TPUSA
claims.claim: The host says Alex Clark clearly planned to drop the trailer about the host on September 10 because TPUSA people blame her for how everyone feels about Erika Kirk and Turning Point USA.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the release time of the Clark trailer and any Clark statement on timing.
claims.transcript_snippet: Alex Clark clearly planning to drop this trailer for an episode which is of course about me. Um because they blame me for how everyone feels about Erika Kirk and Turning Point USA.

claims.label: Host says the FBI has never gone five years without being up to no good
claims.claim: The host says there has never been a period of even five years since the FBI's founding when it was not up to no good.
claims.investigative_direction: Sweeping historical assertion recorded as said; no case-specific check.
claims.transcript_snippet: They've never ever ever have has there ever been a period of even 5 years in this country since their founding period of one year where they were not up to no good.

claims.label: Host says allies sold the public a Superman neck miracle
claims.claim: The host says people around Charlie told the public he had a Superman neck and that it was another modern-day Christian miracle, and that doubters were told they do not like Jesus.
claims.investigative_direction: Trace who first described the neck wound as a miracle and the medical basis claimed.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie had a Superman neck. He ate vegetables. Oh, it was just another modernday Christian miracle.

claims.label: Host says Alex Clark blocked many commenters including the host
claims.claim: The host says Alex Clark blocked a ton of people on her video, including the host, who says she had not even commented under it.
claims.investigative_direction: Screenshot block evidence from affected accounts.
claims.transcript_snippet: She ended up blocking a ton of people, including me. I didn't even comment under her under this video

claims.label: Host says her tribute noted Charlie was attending Mass and hoping to become Catholic, then was called a liar
claims.claim: The host says her tribute video said that Charlie was attending Mass and that people hoped he would become a Catholic, that she was then called a liar, and that Alex Clark did a full episode with Andrew Kolvet asserting she lied without naming her.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the host's tribute wording with the Clark and Kolvet episode and any attendance records.
claims.transcript_snippet: I mentioned in a sentence that he was we were all hoping he was going to take the next step and become a Catholic that he was attending mass and then you all called me a liar

claims.label: Host says TPUSA headquarters has extremely heavy surveillance and gates
claims.claim: The host says that since Charlie Kirk's death TPUSA has extremely heavy surveillance across its campus, with gates and beefed-up security, so footage of the vandal should exist.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask TPUSA or Arizona police whether campus cameras captured the vandalism.
claims.transcript_snippet: they have extremely heavy surveillance all across Turning Point USA's campus. This is a campus, right? They have gates.

claims.label: Host says TPUSA has given no description of the vandals or sought public help
claims.claim: The host says TPUSA has released no information on who vandalized the statue, no footage or description, and is not asking the public for help, directing people to Turning Point Action instead.
claims.investigative_direction: Check for any police bulletin or TPUSA footage release after the 13th.
claims.transcript_snippet: We're getting actually no information from TurningPoint as to uh who vandalized the statue. They're not looking, they're not seeking the public's help

claims.label: Host says Turning Point Action is the 501(c)(4), not the charitable arm
claims.claim: The host says Turning Point Action, where TPUSA is directing supporters, is not the 501(c)(3) charitable arm but the 501(c)(4).

claims.transcript_snippet: Turning Point Action, which is not the 501c3 charitable arm, right? That's their 501c4.

claims.claim: Reading the post, the host says the program is Chase 100 ballots this October and that TPUSA will give volunteers a room and training in Arizona.

claims.transcript_snippet: this is our program, the Chase 100 ballots this October. We will give you a room and training to help us win.

claims.label: Host says Erika's statue tweet repeats a line she has run many times

claims.transcript_snippet: They thought a bullet would silence my husband's voice, but it only made it louder." That line she has run a lot of times.

claims.claim: The host says Vanity Fair contacted her over the weekend, said her comment does not matter because they fact-checked everything, and that the article will be released imminently.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Vanity Fair's publication of the Erika Kirk article and the date of the host's contact.
claims.transcript_snippet: the article is going to be released imminently. They basically asked me if I'd like to comment but said that my comment doesn't actually matter because they fact checked everything.

claims.label: Host says there are rumors Erika Kirk is stepping down
claims.claim: The host says TPUSA is upset about rumors that Erika Kirk is stepping down as head of the company.

claims.transcript_snippet: I know they are upset about the rumors that she's stepping down, but I would say that's the first positive rumor

claims.label: Host asks for tips by email on the footage shown and any footage viewers hold
claims.claim: The host asks viewers to email tips about any of the footage shown that day, or any further footage they hold, to the moretips address.
claims.investigative_direction: Count and triage tips received at the moretips address.
claims.transcript_snippet: More tips at candacewowens. com about any of the footage that we showed today, about anything that you do know.

claims.label: Host seeks a second source for an unnamed doctor who recused himself after something in the room
claims.claim: The host says she is still looking for a second person to confirm that an unnamed doctor, who she is told was in the room during Charlie's surgery at Timpanogos, recused himself from all files due to something that took place in the room.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the surgical team from hospital records and corroborate the recusal with a second source.
claims.transcript_snippet: who we are told uh was in the room when surgery was being conducted on Charlie at Timpanogos and who recused himself from all files due to something that took place in the room.

claims.label: Host says a nurse reports a chest saw was requested during Charlie's care
claims.claim: The host says, allegedly, a nurse at Timpanogos reports that staff asked for a chest saw, which she thought odd given she understood they were operating on his neck, and that she is still working to verify the nurse.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the nurse's employment and presence, and compare with the surgical record.
claims.transcript_snippet: one of the things that they asked for which they thought was out of the normal was a chest saw.

claims.label: Host says pending Harpole lawsuits mean she is withholding some material

claims.transcript_snippet: Some stuff we're not going to share, obviously, because I do have pending lawsuits with Brian Harpole

claims.label: Host says her baby is due within weeks and she will go on leave

claims.transcript_snippet: I only have a few more weeks before this baby comes.

claims.transcript_snippet: he made it clear to several people, not just in one text chain, that he wanted me back.

claims.transcript_snippet: I just know he was scared and he marched on, but he he didn't know who to trust.

claims.transcript_snippet: And then when he suddenly looked up and said, "What's going on with this company?"
